hypothesis: Successive whorl breadths of spiral shells form a geometric progression, i.e. constant ratio per revolution.
pass_criterion: For at least 80% of shells, log whorl breadth versus whorl number has linear fit R^2 of at least 0.98.
fail_criterion: Fewer than 50% of shells reach R^2 of 0.98.
interpretation: The dataset covers gastropods only, so the Nautilus and ammonoid parts (ratio about 3) cannot be tested here. This is a partial test of the stated scope.
